requests.name: V1
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, identity-preserve. EDIT TARGET IS IMAGE1 ONLY: an approved West-facing walk cycle of FOUR EXACT WHOLE-BODY POSES, duplicated as two rows of variants, 4 columns x2 rows. Edit each COMPLETE character, changing its equipment only. Image2 is solely EQUIPMENT reference: twin circular motor saws, black fingerless gloves/cuffs, strapped black leather boots; do NOT copy its guard pose. The target body poses, torso camera, hip/knee/ankle geometry, forward/back foot ownership, short step silhouette, facial age, compact natural brown hair, warm skin and dark-red eyes must remain as in image1. Do not invent a new gait. Col1 contact_A and col2 passing_A are the first half. Col3 contact_B and col4 passing_B are the OPPOSITE leg half: preserve which leg is near/far from the target, and their exact leg silhouette. This opposite leg ownership is essential. BOTH rows repeat these same4exact target poses; second row is an alternate equipment rendering, not different anatomy. Replace silver fist gauntlets with gloved hands each clearly GRIPPING one of the two complete round toothed motor saws, held down beside the thighs in walk position. Replace silver shin armor with the black strapped leather boots while keeping the same short sturdy leg length and each target foot placement. Keep arms generally in their walking positions, slightly adjusted only to visibly grasp handles. Each hand remains attached and each saw has a clear gripped handle; no floating saw, no saw touching or replacing boot. Preserve black coat with red trim/lining, chain, compact adult body proportions. NO elongated legs, NO marching/high knee, NO changing torso camera, NO transformation, NO motorcycle, NO attack/guard. All8whole figures head-to-boots and both weapons complete inside separated cells, generous transparent gutters. All outputs same consistent native adult scale and body density while preserving target joint poses. Sharp square pixel clusters, no blur, no text, transparent background.

Keep coherent W-view body camera and natural gait shoulder swing; no invented new poses. Entire heads,coat,boots,both weapons fit in their generous separated cells.
